mentions.name: The Grand Project
mentions.description: A personal project of listening to every album the author owns—around 855 albums, singles, and EPs—at least once; the author is at 828 and hopes to write a blog post about the experience.
mentions.source_excerpt: Not coding related, I've been on what I've been calling "The Grand Project" for a bit over a year now where I listen to every single album I own (around 855 albums/singles/eps/etc. As of this moment I'm at 828) at least once.
